# Beatbox2MIDI

Comprehensive tool for slicing beatbox transients into MIDI.

## Core Documentation
- [Project State](PROJECT_STATE.md): Current architecture, status, and system capabilities.
- [README](README.md): Project overview and quick start.
- [Slicer interaction Report](Reports/2026-04-26_Slicer_Interaction_Refinement_Report.md): Detailed logic for current interaction model.

## Key Source
- [App.tsx](src/App.tsx): Root component and state coordination.
- [AudioProcessor.js](src/lib/AudioProcessor.js): JS/WASM Bridge.
- [useHitManager.ts](src/hooks/useHitManager.ts): Core DSP state.
- [useAudioPlayback.ts](src/hooks/useAudioPlayback.ts): Web Audio Engine.
- [SlicerCanvas.tsx](src/components/SlicerCanvas.tsx): Primary UI interaction.
- [Transport.tsx](src/components/Transport.tsx): Transport and Metronome logic.
